items.title: Chemistry-Informed Multimodal Model for Structure Elucidation in Automated Reaction Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Rapid and reliable structure elucidation remains a central bottleneck in automated reaction discovery, where highthroughput experimentation can generate large numbers of crude reaction mixtures faster than they can be interpreted. Gas chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (GC-MS) provides rapid and information-rich analytical data, but identification of unknown reaction products still relies heavily on expert interpretation or spectral library matching, limiting applicability to novel compounds. Here we introduce Dynamic Mass-Aware Identification from Reaction Knowledge (DynaMAIK), a multimodal transformer framework for reaction-aware structure elucidation from GC-MS data. DynaMAIK combines electron ionization mass spectra with reaction context encoded as reactant and reagent SMILES to predict product structures and molecular formulas. Trained on more than three million reaction–spectrum pairs derived from curated reaction databases, spectral simulation and experimental spectra, DynaMAIK achieved 87% top-1 and 94% top-10 structure accuracy on a held-out experimental test set. Comparisons with spectrum-only and reaction-only models, together with ablation and scrambling experiments, show that spectral evidence and reaction-derived context provide complementary constraints for product identification. Application to high-throughput thiolation reactions demonstrates accurate product assignment directly from experimental screening data. DynaMAIK establishes context-aware GC-MS interpretation as a scalable route toward automated analytical feedback in reaction discovery workflows.
items.summary_zh: DynaMAIK 是用于自动化反应发现的多模态 Transformer：将 GC-MS 电子电离质谱与以 SMILES 编码的反应物、试剂上下文结合，预测产物结构及分子式。在逾300万反应—谱图对训练后，模型在留出的实验测试集上达到87% top-1、94% top-10 结构准确率，并在高通量硫醇化反应中直接完成实验筛选产物指认。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把反应先验与实测谱图互补整合，可缩短高通量反应发现中“实验生成快、产物解析慢”的瓶颈。结果来自预印本，且对新反应类型、复杂混合物及跨仪器泛化的表现仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 快速而可靠的结构解析仍是自动化反应发现中的核心瓶颈：高通量实验可产生大量粗反应混合物，其生成速度快于可被解析的速度。气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）可提供快速且信息丰富的分析数据，但未知反应产物的鉴定仍高度依赖专家判读或谱库匹配，限制了其对新化合物的适用性。本文提出 Dynamic Mass-Aware Identification from Reaction Knowledge（DynaMAIK），一种用于基于 GC-MS 数据、面向反应的结构解析的多模态 Transformer 框架。DynaMAIK 将电子电离质谱与编码为反应物和试剂 SMILES 的反应上下文结合起来，以预测产物结构和分子式。该模型在来自经整理反应数据库、谱图模拟和实验谱图的超过300万对反应—谱图数据上训练，在留出的实验测试集上实现了87%的 top-1 和94%的 top-10 结构准确率。与仅谱图模型和仅反应模型的比较，以及消融和扰乱实验表明，谱图证据与反应衍生的上下文提供了互补约束。在高通量硫醇化反应中的应用展示了可直接从实验筛选数据准确指认产物。DynaMAIK 将具备上下文感知能力的 GC-MS 解析确立为反应发现工作流中可扩展的自动化分析反馈路径。
items.author_line: Maik G. Niedziella, Philipp M. Pflüger, Ajnabiul Hoque, Frank Glorius

items.title: Data-Driven Exploration of Literature-Derived Catalyst and Reaction Spaces for the Vapor-Phase Aldol Condensation of Acetate with Formaldehyde
items.abstract_or_text: Emerging catalytic processes are often characterized by sparse, heterogeneous, literature-derived datasets, limiting the applicability of conventional predictive machine learning. Herein, we demonstrate a robust approach for extracting mechanistic insights from such challenging datasets using interpretable machine learning. A database comprising 375 observations from 71 publications on the vapor-phase thermocatalytic aldol condensation of acetate with formaldehyde to acrylate was compiled, including catalyst composition, reaction conditions, and catalytic performance. Unsupervised clustering identifies three catalyst families: titanium and vanadium phosphorus oxides, alumina-supported Cs- and Ba-based catalysts, and silica-supported Cs-based catalysts. The small dataset size, restricted catalyst diversity, and inter-study variability result in substantial model overfitting and constrain the accurate prediction of catalyst performance. Robust model development relies on regularized tree-based estimators, publication-grouped cross-validation, and sensitivity analysis across model architectures and random initializations. SHAP analysis identifies liquid hourly space velocity and reactant molar ratio as the dominant operational variables governing acrylate productivity. The presence of water, methanol, or ester-based acetate precursors lowers productivity, while reaction temperature exhibits limited influence. Metal phosphorus oxide and silica-supported Cs materials are ranked as the most and least active catalyst families, respectively. Despite catalyst deactivation being the major limitation, time-on-stream profiles remain largely underreported. Correlation analysis associates the deactivation of metal phosphorus oxide and alumina-supported catalysts primarily with acrylate productivity, consistent with acrylate polymerization, whereas silica-supported Cs catalysts exhibit greater variability, suggesting additional deactivation pathways. Overall, this work provides a transferable framework for extracting reliable insights from sparse literature-derived datasets using interpretable machine learning and robust validation.
items.summary_zh: 研究汇编71篇文献中的375条醋酸酯与甲醛气相热催化羟醛缩合数据，并以发表物分组交叉验证、正则化树模型和 SHAP 分析处理稀疏异质数据。结果识别三类催化剂，指出液时空速和反应物摩尔比是丙烯酸酯生产率的主导变量，同时将失活与产率相关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作展示了在文献来源小数据上避免随机划分虚高性能、提取可审计催化规律的范式。结论受限于催化剂多样性、跨研究可比性以及普遍缺失的 time-on-stream 数据，不能直接替代统一条件下的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 新兴催化过程常以稀疏、异质的文献来源数据集为特征，这限制了常规预测机器学习的适用性。本文展示了一种利用可解释机器学习从这类困难数据集中提取机理洞见的稳健方法。我们汇编了一个数据库，其中包含71篇文献中关于醋酸酯与甲醛气相热催化羟醛缩合生成丙烯酸酯的375条观测，涵盖催化剂组成、反应条件和催化性能。无监督聚类识别出三类催化剂：钛和钒磷氧化物、Al2O3 负载的 Cs 和 Ba 基催化剂，以及 SiO2 负载的 Cs 基催化剂。较小的数据集规模、有限的催化剂多样性和研究间变异导致模型严重过拟合，并限制了对催化剂性能的准确预测。稳健的模型开发依赖于正则化树模型估计器、按发表物分组的交叉验证，以及跨模型架构和随机初始化的敏感性分析。SHAP 分析表明，液时空速和反应物摩尔比是控制丙烯酸酯生产率的主要操作变量。水、甲醇或酯类醋酸酯前体的存在会降低生产率，而反应温度的影响有限。金属磷氧化物和 SiO2 负载 Cs 材料分别被列为活性最高和最低的催化剂家族。尽管催化剂失活是主要限制因素，但 time-on-stream 曲线在很大程度上未被报道。相关性分析将金属磷氧化物和 Al2O3 负载催化剂的失活主要与丙烯酸酯生产率联系起来，这与丙烯酸酯聚合一致；而 SiO2 负载 Cs 催化剂表现出更大的变异性，提示存在额外失活路径。总体而言，这项工作提供了一个可迁移的框架，用于借助可解释机器学习和稳健验证从稀疏、文献来源数据集中提取可靠洞见。
items.author_line: Simon B. Verstraeten, Yayati Naresh Palai, Ekaterina V. Makshina, Bert F. Sels

items.title: Polymer Informatics Atlas: Property-Specific Representations, Chemistry-Aware Generalization, and Reliability-Aware Machine Learning Across Five Polymer Properties
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer-property machine learning is often evaluated as if representation choice, random-split accuracy, chemical extrapolation, transfer learning, uncertainty, and chemical interpretation were a single problem. Here, these questions are separated in a six-stage Polymer Informatics Atlas built from 7,973 unique RDKit-valid polymer repeat units in the NeurIPS Open Polymer Prediction 2025 dataset. Thirty-six interpretable composition/structure descriptors and radius-4, 2,048-dimensional count Morgan fingerprints were evaluated independently and as a hybrid representation for glass-transition temperature (Tg), fractional free volume (FFV), thermal conductivity (Tc), density, and radius of gyration (Rg). Frozen property-specific models achieved untouched random-holdout R2 values of 0.608, 0.704, 0.825, 0.920, and 0.703, respectively. However, chemistry-separated testing changed this interpretation substantially: Tc fell to R2 = 0.326, whereas density remained comparatively robust at R2 = 0.874. Representation-block permutation showed that density was predominantly captured by interpretable global chemistry, while Tc and Rg depended more strongly on local/topological structure; Tg and FFV required mixed information. Masked multitask learning on the overlapping Tc-Density-Rg block used incomplete labels more efficiently than complete-case training, but gains over matched single-task neural networks were small and seed dependent. Five-member ensembles combined with splitconformal calibration produced 90% nominal intervals with empirical coverages of 95.7% (Tc), 92.3% (density), and 98.5% (Rg). Finally, 28 predictive Morgan indices were decoded to atom-centred environments after exact fingerprint-regeneration audits, and an integrated descriptor/fingerprint manifold was used for chemical-space visualization, archetype selection, and an illustrative high-Tc/low-density Pareto analysis. The results support a property-specific, domain-aware view of polymer informatics in which predictive accuracy is reported together with chemical support, uncertainty, and explicit claim boundaries rather than as a single global score.
items.summary_zh: 该聚合物信息学研究在 NeurIPS Open Polymer Prediction 2025 的7,973个 RDKit-valid 重复单元上，比较描述符、Morgan 指纹及混合表征对 Tg、FFV、Tc、密度和 Rg 的预测。它进一步以化学分割、掩码多任务学习、集成与 split-conformal 校准检验模型外推性和不确定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作强调随机划分高分不能代表化学外推能力，并给出属性依赖的表征和不确定性报告框架。数据集和结论仍主要局限于所用聚合物化学空间，模型尚未构成对新材料可合成性或实际性能的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 聚合物性质机器学习常被评价为好像表征选择、随机划分准确率、化学外推、迁移学习、不确定性和化学解释是同一个问题。本文在由 NeurIPS Open Polymer Prediction 2025 数据集中的7,973个独特且 RDKit-valid 的聚合物重复单元构建的六阶段 Polymer Informatics Atlas 中，将这些问题分开考察。针对玻璃化转变温度（Tg）、自由体积分数（FFV）、热导率（Tc）、密度和回转半径（Rg），独立评估并组合评估了36个可解释的组成/结构描述符和半径为4、维度为2,048的计数型 Morgan 指纹。冻结的、性质特异性模型在未触及的随机留出集上分别实现 R2 为0.608、0.704、0.825、0.920和0.703。然而，按化学类别分离的测试显著改变了这一解释：Tc 降至 R2 = 0.326，而密度仍相对稳健，R2 = 0.874。表征模块置换显示，密度主要由可解释的全局化学信息捕获，而 Tc 和 Rg 更强地依赖局部/拓扑结构；Tg 和 FFV 则需要混合信息。针对重叠的 Tc-Density-Rg 模块，掩码多任务学习比完整案例训练更有效地利用了不完整标签，但相对匹配的单任务神经网络的增益很小且依赖随机种子。由五个成员组成的集成结合 split-conformal 校准，产生名义覆盖率为90%的区间，其经验覆盖率分别为95.7%（Tc）、92.3%（density）和98.5%（Rg）。最后，经过精确指纹再生成审计后，28个预测性 Morgan 索引被解码为以原子为中心的环境；并使用整合的描述符/指纹流形进行化学空间可视化、原型选择及示例性的高 Tc/低密度 Pareto 分析。结果支持一种属性特异、域感知的聚合物信息学观点：预测准确率应与化学支持、不确定性和明确的主张边界共同报告，而非作为单一的全局指标。

items.title: From Silicon to Carbon: Experimental Validation of Generative AI-Derived CNS Drug Candidates — A Systematic Review (2021–2026)
items.abstract_or_text: Background Generative artificial intelligence has gained traction as an approach for designing novel CNS-relevant drug candidates, yet the extent to which computationally generated molecules undergo experimental validation remains poorly characterised. Methods A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines using a prospectively registered protocol (OSF: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/JE2DY). PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, arXiv, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched to March 2026. Eligible studies applied generative AI approaches to CNS-relevant targets and reported experimental wet laboratory validation. Titles and abstracts were screened independently by three reviewers; full-text screening, extraction, and quality appraisal were performed independently in duplicate. Findings were synthesised narratively; no meta-analysis was performed. Results Six studies met the inclusion criteria from 374 identified records. All performed in vitro validation; two additionally provided in vivo evidence. Despite CNS-focused objectives, one of six experimentally validated blood–brain barrier permeability. Three studies confirmed their primary computational predictions experimentally, whereas three showed partial confirmation. Validation rates, calculated as confirmed active compounds divided by compounds tested, ranged from 26 to 100 percent; these rates reflect differing selection stringency and are not directly comparable. Publicly accessible code was unavailable in four of six studies. Conclusions Among studies reaching experimental validation, blood–brain barrier confirmation, in vivo evidence, and code availability remain the exception. Because eligibility required reported validation, these findings describe successful translations and cannot estimate failure rates; they nonetheless indicate that validation depth, rather than molecular generation, is the current constraint in this field.
items.summary_zh: 这项按 PRISMA 2020 和预注册方案开展的系统综述检索至2026年3月，纳入6项对生成式 AI 中枢神经系统候选药物进行湿实验验证的研究。全部研究有体外验证，仅2项含体内证据，且仅1项实测血脑屏障通透性；确认活性化合物比例为26%至100%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以证据汇总而非成功案例宣传，指出 CNS 药物生成的关键短板是血脑屏障、体内验证和代码开放，而非分子生成本身。纳入标准要求已有实验验证，因此不能据此估计生成式 AI 项目的总体失败率。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：生成式人工智能作为设计新型中枢神经系统相关候选药物的方法日益受到关注，但计算生成的分子接受实验验证的程度仍缺乏充分表征。方法：我们依据 PRISMA 2020 指南，使用前瞻性注册的方案（OSF: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/JE2DY）开展系统综述。检索了 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、arXiv 和 ClinicalTrials.gov，检索截止至2026年3月。符合条件的研究须将生成式 AI 方法用于中枢神经系统相关靶点，并报告实验湿实验验证。三名审阅者独立筛选题名和摘要；全文筛选、信息提取和质量评价均由两名审阅者独立完成。研究结果以叙述方式综合，不进行 Meta 分析。结果：在识别出的374条记录中，6项研究符合纳入标准。所有研究均开展了体外验证，其中2项还提供了体内证据。尽管目标聚焦中枢神经系统，6项研究中只有1项对血脑屏障通透性进行了实验验证。3项研究通过实验确认了其主要计算预测，另外3项仅得到部分确认。验证率按已确认的活性化合物数除以测试化合物数计算，范围为26%至100%；这些比率反映了不同的筛选严格程度，不能直接比较。6项研究中有4项没有公开可访问的代码。结论：在达到实验验证阶段的研究中，血脑屏障确认、体内证据和代码可获得性仍属例外。由于纳入资格要求报告验证，这些发现描述的是成功转化案例，无法估计失败率；但它们仍表明，当前该领域的限制在于验证深度，而非分子生成。
items.author_line: Jad Awwad, Gul e Sehar, Fiona Benny, Obert Mutumba, Sukanya Mondal, Esha Shahbaz, Rishit Jangam, Shusant Upreti

items.title: Bottom-up design of the operating window for direct urea synthesis from first-principles molecular thermodynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Urea, among the most widely utilized foods for crops, is mass-produced via the carbon-and energy-intensive Bosch–Meiser process. However, its operating condition is settled empirically, vulnerable to undersampling and suboptimal production, and its molecular mechanism is not well understood. Here we present a bottom-up design of the operating condition driven by first-principles molecular modeling. Using a machine learning force field trained on first-principles calculations of urea and relevant species, we explored the free energy surface of the reaction space from reactant to product across temperatures. We found a strong thermodynamic preference for acyl substitution over competing pathways, with a free energy minimum around 420 K arising from the balance between carbamic acid’s protonation ratio and solvation number, which respectively increase and decrease with temperature. And we confirmed that the optimal condition originates from near-critical behavior, showing a fixed ratio to the critical temperature below unity. The maximum-yield temperatures of simulation and experiment correspond when scaled to their critical temperatures, suggesting this combined approach for engineering the operating condition.
items.summary_zh: 研究以由第一性原理计算训练的机器学习力场，扫描尿素直接合成从反应物到产物、跨温度的自由能面。模型预测酰基取代具有热力学优势，并在约420 K 出现自由能最低点；按临界温度缩放后，模拟与实验的最高产率温度相对应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将 ML 力场与分子热力学联系到工业反应条件设计，提出可检验的近临界操作窗口。摘要未给出产率、误差或不同工况的系统实验细节，工程可迁移性仍应审慎评估。
items.abstract_zh: 尿素是作物中使用最广泛的养分之一，通过高碳耗和高能耗的 Bosch–Meiser 工艺大规模生产。然而，其操作条件由经验确定，容易受到采样不足和非最优生产的影响，而且其分子机制尚不清楚。本文提出由第一性原理分子建模驱动的、自下而上的操作条件设计。我们使用一个由尿素及相关物种的第一性原理计算训练的机器学习力场，探索了跨温度条件下从反应物到产物的反应空间自由能面。我们发现，相比竞争路径，酰基取代具有很强的热力学偏好；由于氨基甲酸的质子化比例和溶剂化数之间的平衡，在约420 K 处出现自由能最低点，二者分别随温度升高和降低。我们还确认最优条件源于近临界行为，表现为低于1的、相对于临界温度的固定比值。当按各自临界温度缩放时，模拟和实验的最高产率温度相对应，表明该联合方法可用于操作条件工程设计。
items.author_line: Minwoo Kim, Seungtae Kim, Ji Woong Yu, Won Bo Lee

items.title: From 4D to 2D: Efficient computation of the electron correlation energies of atoms in molecular systems
items.abstract_or_text: The accurate modeling of (bio)molecular systems remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. In recent years, machine learning potentials (MLPs) have emerged as a promising approach, combining the efficiency of classical force fields with near quantum-mechanical accuracy. Among these, the physics-informed MLP FFLUX employs the Interacting Quantum Atoms (IQA) energy partitioning scheme to decompose molecular energies into atomic contributions derived from quantum mechanics for machine learning. However, incorporating two-electron correlation energies into IQA, and consequently into FFLUX, is currently unfeasible for larger systems en masse, due to the steep computational scaling associated with the necessary storage and evaluation of the two-particle density matrix (2PDM). In this work, we introduce a proof-of-concept workflow that employs density fitting (DF) to compress the 2PDM into a two-index representation, thereby accelerating the IQA partitioning of two-electron correlation energies. By expressing traditionally four-centre electron repulsion integrals in terms of auxiliary basis functions, the DF approximation enables a size reduction of the 2PDM from O(N^4) to O(NDF^2), where N is the number of basis functions and NDF is the size of the auxiliary basis set. The method proposed here is demonstrated using coupled cluster singles and doubles densities. The resulting reduction in computational cost and memory requirements enables correlated IQA analyses for significantly larger systems than previously accessible. Thus, this development provides an important step towards incorporating explicit electron correlation and hence dispersion directly into FFLUX atomic ML models, thereby improving both their physical robustness and transferability. This advance will eliminate the need to artificially add empirical potentials, or a posteriori dispersion correction.
items.summary_zh: 该概念验证以 density fitting 将两粒子密度矩阵压缩为双指标表征，使 IQA 框架中两电子关联能的计算从 O(N^4) 存储规模降至 O(NDF^2)。方法用 CCSD 密度演示，目标是将显式电子关联和色散纳入 FFLUX 原子机器学习模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这为物理信息机器学习势兼顾量子化学关联能与可计算性提供了关键技术路线。现阶段是概念验证，尚需在更大分子、动力学模拟及与经验色散修正的实际精度和成本比较中检验。
items.abstract_zh: 对（生物）分子体系的准确建模仍是计算化学中的重大挑战。近年来，机器学习势（MLPs）作为一种有前景的方法出现，将经典力场的效率与接近量子力学的准确性相结合。其中，物理信息机器学习势 FFLUX 使用 Interacting Quantum Atoms（IQA）能量分解方案，将分子能量分解为源于量子力学的原子贡献以供机器学习。然而，由于存储和评估两粒子密度矩阵（2PDM）所需计算量的急剧标度，目前无法大规模地将两电子关联能纳入 IQA，因而也无法纳入 FFLUX。本文提出一个概念验证工作流，采用 density fitting（DF）将 2PDM 压缩为双指标表征，从而加速两电子关联能的 IQA 分解。通过将传统四中心电子排斥积分表示为辅助基函数，DF 近似使 2PDM 的规模从 O(N^4) 降至 O(NDF^2)，其中 N 是基函数数目，NDF 是辅助基组的大小。这里提出的方法使用 coupled cluster singles and doubles 密度进行演示。由此带来的计算成本和内存需求降低，使得对比以往可处理体系大得多的体系进行关联 IQA 分析成为可能。因此，这一进展为将显式电子关联、进而将色散直接纳入 FFLUX 原子 ML 模型迈出了重要一步，从而提高其物理稳健性和可迁移性。该进展将消除人为加入经验势或事后色散校正的需要。
items.author_line: Prasanta Bandyopadhyay, Gyula Samu, Mark A. Vincent, Olivia P. Aten, Peter R. Nagy, Paul L. A. Popelier

items.title: Active Confinement Catalysis Powered by Mechanical Force.
items.abstract_or_text: The design of artificial enzyme mimics has long been guided by the paradigm of crafting static pockets for transition-state stabilization, a process reliant on stochastic molecular diffusion. These passive events impose a rate limit, and a strict criterion for substrates with suitable size and electronic matching. Inspired by biological ion pumps that drive uphill ion transport using chemical fuels, we propose that mechanical force can power an active, out-of-equilibrium catalytic pumping cycle. We herein report a solid-state mechanochemical strategy where mechanical input drives a confinement catalyst 1 ( Pd 2 L 2 ) from a closed to an open “active” state, while simultaneously pumping substrate molecules into its active site for catalytic events. This dynamic catalyst exhibits substrate size and shape recognition, and its mechano-pump mechanism is quantitatively validated by Michaelis-Menten saturation kinetics, where catalytic efficiency scales directly with the applied force. Moreover, the active-pump action overcomes inherent electrostatic repulsion, enabling cationic substrates, normally excluded from the cationic host catalysts, to be efficiently drawn in and engaged in catalytic turnover. This force-induced pumping catalysis concept is smoothly extended to photochemistry. By combining a photosensitizing unit and an active confinement catalyst, an active pumping mechano-photoredox C-H oxidation process is developed. This work establishes mechanical force not merely as a synthetic tool, but as a fundamental design parameter for catalysts, opening a pathway to life-like chemical control in which energy transduction, not just static structure, dictates function.
items.summary_zh: 工作报告一种 Pd2L2 限域催化剂：机械输入同时使其由闭合态转为开放活性态，并将底物泵入活性位点。作者以 Michaelis–Menten 饱和动力学量化该机制，显示催化效率随外加力提高，并将体系扩展到机械驱动光氧化还原 C–H 氧化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这提出了以能量转导而非静态结合口袋控制限域催化的新设计原则，并能克服同号主体与阳离子底物之间的静电排斥。其适用底物、循环寿命和放大条件仍需在更广泛反应体系中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 人工酶模拟物的设计长期遵循为过渡态稳定化构建静态口袋的范式，该过程依赖随机分子扩散。这些被动事件施加了速率限制，并对具有合适尺寸和电子匹配的底物提出严格要求。受利用化学燃料驱动离子逆浓度梯度运输的生物离子泵启发，我们提出机械力可以为主动、非平衡催化泵送循环提供动力。本文报道一种固态机械化学策略：机械输入驱动限域催化剂1（Pd2L2）从闭合态转变为开放的“活性”状态，同时将底物分子泵入其活性位点以进行催化事件。该动态催化剂表现出底物尺寸和形状识别能力，其机械泵送机制通过 Michaelis–Menten 饱和动力学得到定量验证，催化效率随施加力直接增加。更重要的是，主动泵送作用克服了固有静电排斥，使通常被阳离子主体催化剂排斥的阳离子底物能够被有效吸入并参与催化周转。该力诱导泵送催化概念可顺利扩展至光化学。通过结合一个光敏化单元和一个主动限域催化剂，开发了主动泵送的机械-光氧化还原 C–H 氧化过程。这项工作确立机械力不仅是一种合成工具，更是催化剂的基本设计参数，为一种由能量转导而非仅由静态结构决定功能的类生命化学控制开辟了路径。
items.author_line: Shi Li, Fang-Zi Liu, Xinhan Liu, Yan Liu, Jian Wang, KaKing Yan

items.title: Beyond Recognition Chemistry: Ion Sensing through Intrinsic Electrochemical InterfacialResponse
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable ion sensing across multicomponent and dynamically changing environments is important in environmental monitoring, industrial process control, and biological analysis. In conventional electrochemical sensors, ion selectivity is typically achieved through redox reactions, ion-selective membranes, or molecular recognition layers, requiring ion-specific chemistry or materials to distinguish the target species. Yet dissolved ions also modify the intrinsic electrical structure of the electrode–electrolyte interface through differences in valence, hydrated size, mobility, polarizability, hydration energetics, and ion–surface interactions. These effects alter solvent organization, charge screening, ion accumulation, dielectric response, and transport within the electric double layer, creating composition-dependent electrical signatures without deliberately introduced receptors. Exploiting these intrinsic responses therefore offers an alternative basis for extracting ion-specific information from the interface itself. This review critically examines recognition-free ion sensing based on such intrinsic interfacial processes, with particular emphasis on non-Faradaic approaches. We first establish the physical origins of ion-dependent interfacial structure and examine how these differences are translated into measurable electrical responses, including capacitance, impedance, electronic channel modulation, ionic transport, and electrokinetic signals. The evolution of recognition-free sensing is then evaluated according to increasing analytical capability, from ion-dependent response and discrimination to single-analyte and multicomponent quantification. This analysis reveals that quantitative capability has advanced substantially, particularly through multidimensional electrical measurements and machine learning, but remains concentrated largely in simple solutions and controlled mixtures. Translation to complex and real matrices therefore represents a major unresolved frontier. Future progress will require deeper understanding of competitive multicomponent interfaces, deliberate control of interfacial properties, informative perturbation of the sensing environment, and data-driven analysis that remains connected to underlying physicochemical processes. Recognition-free sensing thus provides a route toward quantitative ion analysis in which analytical information is encoded by the interface itself rather than imposed exclusively through molecular recognition chemistry.
items.summary_zh: 该综述梳理无需特异识别元件、而是读取电极—电解质界面固有电学响应的离子传感路线，涵盖电容、阻抗、电子通道调制、离子传输和电动学信号。作者指出多维电学测量与机器学习已提升定量能力，但主要限于简单溶液和受控混合物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为面向复杂离子体系的化学传感提出了物理可解释的数据驱动方向，而非单纯叠加识别层。该文是综述，且复杂真实基质中的竞争界面效应仍未解决，尚不能视作现场分析性能的直接证据。
items.abstract_zh: 在多组分和动态变化环境中进行可靠离子传感，对于环境监测、工业过程控制和生物分析十分重要。在传统电化学传感器中，离子选择性通常通过氧化还原反应、离子选择性膜或分子识别层实现，需要离子特异的化学或材料来区分目标物种。然而，溶解离子也会通过价态、水合尺寸、迁移率、可极化性、水合能和离子—表面相互作用的差异，改变电极—电解质界面的固有电结构。这些效应改变电双层中的溶剂组织、电荷屏蔽、离子积累、介电响应和传输，在不特意引入受体的情况下产生与组成有关的电学特征。因此，利用这些固有响应为从界面本身提取离子特异信息提供了另一种基础。本文批判性审视了基于这类固有界面过程的无识别离子传感，尤其关注非 Faradaic 方法。我们首先确立离子依赖性界面结构的物理起源，并考察这些差异如何转化为可测量的电学响应，包括电容、阻抗、电子通道调制、离子传输和电动学信号。随后，根据分析能力的提升评估无识别传感的发展，从离子依赖性响应和区分，到单分析物与多组分定量。该分析显示，定量能力已显著进展，特别是通过多维电学测量和机器学习，但仍主要集中于简单溶液和受控混合物。因此，向复杂真实基质的转化仍是一个重要未解前沿。未来进展将需要更深入理解竞争性多组分界面、对界面性质进行有目的的控制、对传感环境施加信息丰富的扰动，以及仍与底层物理化学过程相联系的数据驱动分析。因此，无识别传感提供了一条定量离子分析路径，其中分析信息由界面本身编码，而非完全由分子识别化学施加。
items.author_line: Amir Mohseni Armaki, M. Ahmadi, A. Mol, P. Taheri, Amir Mohseni Armaki

items.title: Dearomative Multifunctionalization of Benzene Rings Enabled by Electron-Transfer Catalysis
items.abstract_or_text: Transforming simple benzene-ring-containing compounds from bulk chemicals into complex three-dimensional molecules with diverse functionalities and controllable stereochemistry under mild, scalable conditions remains a long-standing goal in synthetic chemistry. Dianions generated from aryl carbonyl compounds by two-electron transfer are promising precursors for dearomative difunctionalization. However, previous methods1 for generating dianion intermediates require harsh conditions and are incompatible with functionalized electrophiles, while competing benzylic functionalization via ketyl radical anions2,3 further limits their application. A key challenge is therefore to rapidly convert radical anions into higher-energy dianions using a mild reducing agent, outcompeting nucleophilic reactions of radical anions while ensuring electrophile compatibility. Here we report an ultrafast electron-transfer catalytic mode employing a bipyridine-based catalyst that rapidly acquires electrons from magnesium metal and transfers them to aryl ketyl radical anions, enabling the efficient in situ generation of dianion intermediates from simple aryl ketones under mild conditions. Using chlorosilanes as electrophiles, we obtain dearomatized bis-silylated products bearing conjugated enol silyl ether and allylsilane motifs in up to 98% yield. These products serve as versatile platform molecules for dearomative multifunctionalization, enabling the highly stereoselective synthesis of complex compounds with multiple stereocentres.
items.summary_zh: 研究以联吡啶催化剂介导 Mg 向芳基酮 ketyl radical anion 的超快电子转移，在温和条件下原位生成二阴离子，并借助氯硅烷获得最高98%产率的去芳构化双硅基化产物。产物含共轭 enol silyl ether 与 allylsilane 基元，可用于高立体选择性构筑多手性中心分子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法以电子转移催化解决自由基阴离子竞争反应与亲电试剂兼容性的矛盾，拓展了芳基酮的三维化学空间。其与AI的直接关联有限，且底物范围、官能团耐受性和放大表现需以全文数据判断。
items.abstract_zh: 在温和、可放大的条件下，将含有简单苯环的化合物从大宗化学品转化为具有多种官能团和可控立体化学的复杂三维分子，仍是合成化学长期追求的目标。通过双电子转移由芳基羰基化合物生成的二阴离子，是去芳构化双官能团化的有前景前体。然而，以往生成二阴离子中间体的方法需要苛刻条件，并且与带官能团的亲电试剂不相容；经由 ketyl radical anion 发生竞争性苄位官能团化进一步限制了其应用。因此，关键挑战是在确保亲电试剂兼容性的同时，利用温和还原剂将自由基阴离子迅速转化为高能二阴离子，从而胜过自由基阴离子的亲核反应。本文报道一种超快电子转移催化模式，采用基于联吡啶的催化剂：该催化剂迅速从金属镁获得电子，并将其转移给芳基 ketyl radical anion，使简单芳基酮在温和条件下高效原位生成二阴离子中间体。使用氯硅烷作为亲电试剂，我们获得带有共轭 enol silyl ether 和 allylsilane 基元的去芳构化双硅基化产物，产率最高可达98%。这些产物作为去芳构化多官能团化的多用途平台分子，可用于高度立体选择性地合成含多个立体中心的复杂化合物。
items.author_line: Meng Li, Nan-Nan Li, Cai-Lan Kou, Zi-Yi Chen, Xi Luo, Jian-Bo Xie

items.title: Comprehensive Strategies in the Synthesis of Noncanonical Cyclic Peptides Containing Biaryl-Bridged Linkages
items.abstract_or_text: CONSPECTUS: The development of synthetic methodologies for natural products and the establishment of chemical supply routes for complex compounds, which advanced significantly in the twentieth century, provided organic chemists in both academia and industry with considerable confidence and assurance. These achievements offered humanity a systematic framework and a degree of sustainability in the supply of complex organic molecules. Established synthetic strategies enabled access, to a certain extent, to diverse bioactive compounds such as terpenes, alkaloids, and peptides. The isolation of bioactive natural products has often been compared to the extraction of crude oil, and we are repeatedly taught that the major bioactive natural products or their core scaffolds have already been “almost completely isolated.” Yet such a sense of accomplishment is frequently illusory. In reality, isolation techniques for bioactive natural products have advanced dramatically over time, and reports of newly isolated bioactive compounds continue to appear with vigor. In recent decades, the rapid progress of genome mining since the early 2000s has enabled the computational analysis of genetic information to uncover novel bioactive substances with pharmaceutical potential. This technology revealed that many organisms harbor, within their genomes, numerous beneficial bioactive compounds that are not produced under conventional environmental conditions. Consequently, a surge of discoveries—akin to a gold rush—has been reported. Among these natural products are compounds with previously unknown and distinctive scaffolds, many of which lack established synthetic supply routes. Notable examples include cihunamide B, lapparbin, micitide 982, rubrin, scabrirubin CB-4, and cyctetryptomycin A, all of which represent recently isolated noncanonical cyclic peptides characterized by biaryl-bridged linkages. Most of these compounds were discovered through genome mining and are distinguished by rigid architectures in which two aromatic rings, such as tryptophan and tyrosine, are covalently linked within the cyclic peptide framework. The presence of multiple highly conjugated sp2 carbons imparts pronounced linearity to the cyclic peptide backbone, concomitantly increasing structural strain. As a result, conventional strategies for cyclic peptide synthesis—such as intramolecular amide coupling, intramolecular Ullmann coupling, or intramolecular oxidative cyclization—are inadequate for constructing these highly strained biarylbridged cyclic peptides. We have recently established a general modular synthetic approach for these noncanonical cyclic peptides, enabling their supply on the gram scale. Most notably, this methodology not only permits the synthesis of naturally occurring biaryl-bridged linkages but also allows the deliberate incorporation of diverse, artificially designed aromatic motifs into arbitrary peptide linkers. Within the vast genetic “ocean” encoded in microbial genomes, numerous cryptic natural products with unprecedented scaffolds are expected to remain undiscovered. The systematic synthetic strategy we present herein provides a general and coherent framework that enables access to these compound classes, which until now have been exclusively available through microbial biosynthesis. Moreover, recent advances in photochemical and electrochemical methodologies, particularly inexpensive and mild radical reactions, have proven to be highly effective approaches for the synthesis of these previously unexplored natural products. These cutting-edge single-electron processes are not merely substitutes for classical two-electron name reactions; rather, they have emerged as powerful tools for navigating the genomic “ocean” and uncovering new chemical space.
items.summary_zh: 文章综述并提出一套用于含 biaryl-bridged linkage 非经典环肽的模块化合成策略，可克级供应天然连接方式，也允许向任意肽连接体引入人工芳香基元。其背景是 genome mining 持续发现缺乏合成供应路线、构象刚性的环肽天然产物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模块化、可放大的合成供应有助于将基因组挖掘发现转为可开展构效与药理研究的分子实体。本文偏重方法与综述性主张，具体底物覆盖范围、收率和生物活性仍需查看原始实验数据。
items.abstract_zh: CONSpectus：二十世纪中显著发展的天然产物合成方法学，以及为复杂化合物建立化学供应路线，使学术界和工业界的有机化学家获得了相当大的信心和把握。这些成就为人类提供了复杂有机分子供应的系统框架和一定程度的可持续性。既有合成策略在一定程度上使多样的生物活性化合物成为可获得对象，例如萜类、生物碱和肽。生物活性天然产物的分离常被比作原油开采，而我们反复被教导主要的生物活性天然产物或其核心骨架已经“几乎完全被分离”。然而，这种成就感常常是一种幻觉。实际上，生物活性天然产物的分离技术随时间大幅进步，新分离生物活性化合物的报道仍不断涌现。近几十年来，自21世纪初以来 genome mining 的快速发展使人们能够对遗传信息进行计算分析，以发现具有药物潜力的新型生物活性物质。这一技术揭示，许多生物体的基因组中含有大量在常规环境条件下并不产生的有益生物活性化合物。因此，类似淘金热的发现浪潮不断出现。这些天然产物包括具有此前未知且独特骨架的化合物，其中许多尚无既定的合成供应路线。值得注意的实例包括 cihunamide B、lapparbin、micitide 982、rubrin、scabrirubin CB-4 和 cyctetryptomycin A；它们都是近来分离得到的、以 biaryl-bridged linkage 为特征的非经典环肽。这些化合物大多通过 genome mining 发现，其特点是在环肽框架内，两个芳香环如色氨酸和酪氨酸以共价方式连接，形成刚性构筑。多个高度共轭 sp2 碳的存在赋予环肽主链明显的线性，同时增加结构张力。因此，常规的环肽合成策略，例如分子内酰胺偶联、分子内 Ullmann 偶联或分子内氧化环化，均不足以构建这些高度张力的 biaryl-bridged 环肽。我们最近建立了一种适用于这些非经典环肽的通用模块化合成方法，使其能够以克级供应。最重要的是，这一方法不仅能够合成天然存在的 biaryl-bridged linkage，还允许将多种人工设计的芳香基元有意引入任意肽连接体。在由微生物基因组编码的广阔遗传“海洋”中，预计仍有许多具有前所未有骨架的隐蔽天然产物尚未被发现。我们提出的系统合成策略提供了一个通用且连贯的框架，使这些迄今只能通过微生物生物合成获得的化合物类别变得可及。此外，光化学和电化学方法学的近期进展，尤其是廉价温和的自由基反应，已被证明是合成这些此前未被探索天然产物的高效方法。这些前沿的单电子过程并非仅仅是经典双电子命名反应的替代物；它们已成为遨游基因组“海洋”并开拓新化学空间的有力工具。

items.title: High-Entropy Catalysts for Lithium-Sulfur and
items.abstract_or_text: Lithium-sulfur (Li-S) and room-temperature sodium-sulfur (RT Na-S) batteries offer high theoretical energy density at low materials cost, but the insulating nature of sulfur, the shuttling of soluble polysulfides, and sluggish multistep redox kinetics limit their practical use. Catalysts that anchor polysulfides and accelerate their conversion are a widely investigated remedy, and the field is moving from single-metal catalysts toward high-entropy catalysts (HECs) built from five or more principal elements. This review is organized around the electronic descriptors, principally the d-band center and its refinements, that are used to connect multi-element composition to polysulfide adsorption and to reaction barriers. We define configurational entropy quantitatively, separate genuine HECs from lower-order multimetal catalysts, survey the alloy, oxide, sulfide, and single-atom families with attention to mechanism and limitations, and treat the still under-demonstrated RT Na-S case explicitly. We then examine the first-principles workflow required for chemically disordered surfaces and the emerging, mostly non-sulfur, use of machine learning (ML). Our central conclusion is that the d-band center is a useful but non-universal descriptor whose predictive value depends on local coordination, oxidation state, surface reconstruction, solvation, and polysulfide coverage, and that direct evidence for entropy-derived synergy, and for high-entropy catalysis in RT Na-S specifically, remains incomplete.
items.summary_zh: 该综述以 d-band center 等电子描述符为主线，评估由五种或更多主元素构成的 high-entropy catalysts 在 Li-S 与 RT Na-S 电池中吸附多硫化物、降低转化势垒的机制，并讨论无序表面的第一性原理工作流及机器学习的早期应用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章明确区分真正 HEC 与低阶多金属催化剂，并指出熵协同与 RT Na-S 高熵催化的直接证据仍不足，为数据驱动材料设计划出必要边界。它是综述而非新模型或电池验证，ML 在硫电池体系中的实证应用仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 锂硫（Li-S）和室温钠硫（RT Na-S）电池以较低材料成本提供高理论能量密度，但硫的绝缘性、可溶性多硫化物的穿梭以及缓慢的多步氧化还原动力学限制了其实际应用。能够锚定多硫化物并加速其转化的催化剂是广受研究的解决方案，该领域正从单金属催化剂转向由五种或更多主元素构成的 high-entropy catalysts（HECs）。本文综述围绕电子描述符展开，主要是 d-band center 及其改进形式；这些描述符用于将多元素组成与多硫化物吸附和反应势垒联系起来。我们定量定义构型熵，将真正的 HECs 与低阶多金属催化剂区分开来，综述合金、氧化物、硫化物和单原子家族，并关注其机制和局限性，同时明确讨论尚未得到充分验证的 RT Na-S 情形。随后，我们考察了化学无序表面所需的第一性原理工作流，以及机器学习（ML）正在出现的、主要并非面向硫体系的应用。我们的核心结论是，d-band center 是有用但并非普适的描述符，其预测价值取决于局部配位、氧化态、表面重构、溶剂化和多硫化物覆盖度；而对于由熵产生协同作用的直接证据，以及 RT Na-S 中高熵催化的直接证据，仍不充分。
items.author_line: Nusrat Jahan Hridita, Md. Safin Mahmood Shomyo

review.note: 按AI×化学相关性、创新性与证据强度排序，保留12项。未纳入仅有虚拟筛选而无实验支持、AI关联较弱或摘要文本不完整的候选。
